_note: Prepared answers: the questions people ask most, answered with no model call (app/assistant/prepared.py). ask: ways people say it, matched after normalizing (case, punctuation, 1,000 = 1000, PAXG = gold, Thai particles). An answer is do (a fast-path intent: show, show_price, trade, period, freeze, hide, back, cancel, steps, guide, compare, explain_chart, portfolio, price, advice), say (fixed text, or a template with slots filled from the fact packs when asked: {XAU.price} {XAU.today} {XAU.today_short} {BTC.1Y} {BTC.1Y_short} {ETH.about} {XAU.Name} {here.price} {fees.pct} {fees.min_fee} {fees.min_buy} {fees.1000}), or glossary (a term in glossary.json). Keep say to one short, plain sentence, no em dashes. Every glossary term also answers 'what is <term>' by itself. List only ways that clearly ARE the question, with its key words: never a vague or open one ('help', 'is it safe', 'what is this', 'explain'), which depends on the screen or the conversation and goes to the model, so it gets a real answer. Thai needs a Thai speaker's check (th_reviewed). The questions that still go to the model are in backend/.runtime/questions.jsonl: add the common ones here.
